about: Photo look (house style for story and philosophy cards).

image.prompt: An eighteenth-century writing desk with a quill, an inkwell and a small leather notebook in candlelight.
Thirteen candles of different heights burning on a dark table, flickering in disarray.

scenes.narration: Work on one habit at a time, not all thirteen at once.

image.prompt: An older gentleman in eighteenth-century clothes with small round spectacles writing at a desk by candlelight, face in soft shadow.
Loose papers blowing across a wooden floor from an open window at night.

scenes.narration: Benjamin Franklin drew up a list of thirteen virtues he wanted to build. Chasing them all at once just scattered his attention.

image.prompt: One candle sharp in focus with a row of unlit candles blurred behind it, shallow depth of field.
A quill pen leaving a small round ink dot on cream paper, macro, candlelight.
A clean sheet of handmade paper on a desk in soft morning light.

scenes.narration: So he gave each virtue a full week of focus, and let the others take their chances. Every evening, a small black dot for each slip, aiming to keep that week's line clean.

image.prompt: A wooden water wheel turning slowly beside an old stone mill at dusk.
An old orchard tree in snow under low golden winter sun.

scenes.narration: Thirteen weeks made a cycle, and he could run four cycles a year.

image.prompt: Hands in worn gardening gloves pulling weeds from one raised garden bed, early morning, soft light.
An overgrown kitchen garden next to one neatly weeded bed, misty morning.

scenes.narration: Like weeding a garden, he worked on one of the beds at a time, not all the bad herbs at once.

image.prompt: Running shoes by a front door in early morning light.
A pencil ticking a small empty box on a plain card on a kitchen table, close up.
A cyclist riding easily along a quiet country road at sunrise.

scenes.narration: The same logic suits habit change today. Pick one behaviour, track it daily, and add the next only once the first feels automatic.

image.prompt: A blank index card and a pencil on a wooden desk under a warm lamp.
A lamp glowing in a cosy room at dusk, blue twilight in the window.

scenes.narration: Choose one habit to focus on this week. Draw seven boxes on a card, and add a dot each evening you slip.
